requirements.text: Students should be able to personalise their timetables by colour-coding modules and hiding cancelled classes.
Students should be able to export their personalised timetables for syncing with applications like Google Calendar or Outlook.
There should be a one-time permission request for students when syncing their timetable with external applications to ensure data protection.
The system should automate notifications for when grades are posted and assignment deadlines are approaching.
Students should be able to choose their preferred communication channels for notifications (email, SMS, in-app).
Students should be able to set the frequency of notifications (instant, daily, weekly).
Students should have the ability to turn specific notifications on or off based on their current workload.
The feedback interface should be intuitive and accessible directly from the portal dashboard.
The feedback form must cover various aspects of the module, including content quality, delivery effectiveness, and available resources.
The feedback form should include rating scales (1 to 5) and open-ended fields for additional comments.
The feedback system must guarantee anonymity for students to encourage honest feedback.
Module coordinators should only have access to feedback after grades have been submitted to avoid bias.
The enhancements must respect existing systems and comply with GDPR regulations.
